result.reply: Ha, yeah — painfully relatable is right, especially the version where the fake citation has a *very* plausible-sounding journal name and a DOI format that's just slightly off. It's basically the same failure mode as a fluent teammate handing you a confident claim: sounds right, isn't backed by anything you can actually check. Difference is I'm at least supposed to say "unverified" out loud instead of inventing a page number.
